description: Postos em operação do Comando Rodoviário da Brigada Militar is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Arquivo vetorial, do tipo "Ponto", dos Postos em operação do Comando Rodoviário da Brigada Militar, órgão da Brigada Militar do RS, responsável em policiar os trechos rodoviários estaduais que compõem o Sistema Rodoviário Estadual do Rio Grande do Sul (SRE-RS). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Downloadable Data, Rio Grande do Sul, Fração Rodoviária, Posto Policial, DAER. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
